title: Moonshine speech to text (Tiny on Metal; larger variants on the CPU reference)

recommended.why: CPU is the default until the Metal peak qualifies: Metal is 10x faster on one clip but holds 315.9 MiB against 119.7

sweeps.description: the Metal engine against the CPU reference; not comparable arms, so read each on its own
sweeps.note: pass --audio-job with a 16 kHz mono WAV; the Metal engine serves the Tiny shapes only

findings.conditions: single readings; memory is why Metal is not the default

open_questions: the Metal engine's memory, before it can be the default
grouped-query and larger variants stay on the CPU reference
traps: the Metal engine refuses a config whose shapes are not the Tiny checkpoint's
